fixture.description: One untextured flat opaque D3D8 XYZ|DIFFUSE DrawPrimitiveUP triangle, with captured nonidentity world, view and perspective projection matrices.

result.comparison: The D3D8 baseline, captured D3D8 run and D3D12 replay P6 PPM byte streams match.
result.image_note: Lossless RGB conversion of the matching reference PPM.

matrix_sensitivity_check.description: For a separate replay, change captured VIEW row-major element [3][0] from approximately -0.05 to +0.15; compare to the unmodified replay.
matrix_sensitivity_check.evidence_note: Observed during the Highball run; mutated packet and output were temporary and have been removed. This checks response to a changed matrix, not parity for the mutated scene.

limitations: Only an isolated synthetic single-triangle DrawPrimitiveUP fixture is tested, not a TDS frame.
The captured row-major world, view and projection matrices are applied on the GPU; the triangle is wholly within the clip volume.
No depth test, vertex or index buffers, textures, shaders from a game, lighting, materials or gameplay were replayed.
RGB equality for this fixture and runtime is not a general D3D8 parity guarantee; the PPM does not preserve alpha.
No native Windows D3D12 GPU, swapchain presentation or GPU timing was validated.
